# Getting started

HARTLE.TECH is a single-operator engineering org (NIPC 518241327, Porto, Portugal). The public surface is a handful of products plus the docs you're reading now.

## Public surfaces

| Surface | Where | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| [hartle.tech](https://hartle.tech) | Netlify | Marketing landing page |
| [docs.hartle.tech](https://docs.hartle.tech) | This site | Public engineering docs |
| [neartrace.app](https://neartrace.app) | Pages | NearTrace product site |
| [medusa.hartle.tech](https://medusa.hartle.tech) | k3s | Medusa product site |
| [dumpsock.hartle.tech](https://dumpsock.hartle.tech) | k3s | DumpSock product site |
| [tools.hartle.tech](https://tools.hartle.tech) | k3s | Per-tool reference cards |

## Internal surfaces (tailnet only)

`wiki.hartle.tech`, `openbao.hartle.tech`, `authentik.hartle.tech`, `headlamp.hartle.tech`, `grafana.hartle.tech`, `flux.hartle.tech` — all require a member-tagged Tailscale device.

## Source code

Everything is on GitHub at [code-hartle-tech](https://github.com/code-hartle-tech). The GitOps repo (`hartle.tech-terraform`) is the one to clone if you want to understand the wiring.
